name: BanglaCHQ-Summ: An Abstractive Summarization Dataset for Medical Queries in Bangla
description: BanglaCHQ-Summ is an abstractive summarization dataset for medical consumer health queries in Bangla conversational speech. Published at EMNLP 2023 BLP workshop, it comprises 2,350 medical query-summary pairs curated to assist automated telehealth consultation, clinical triage, and medical question summarization in Bengali.
